concerns.text: FR-005 requires computing the cosine similarity between the final accumulated update direction of each variant and the standard PPO baseline. No task in tasks.md explicitly performs or logs this final‑alignment computation (e.g., a task to calculate and store a final alignment metric after training).

FR-007 mandates mixed‑precision (FP16) training on CPU. The task list contains memory and time budgeting tasks but lacks any task that verifies FP16 is enabled for the training runs (e.g., a unit test or validation step checking torch dtype or a configuration flag).

SC-002 calls for measuring the final subspace alignment (cosine similarity of final update direction). No task is defined to compute, record, or report this final alignment score; existing tasks only assert per‑step similarity (T028) or early‑trajectory alignment (T018d‑align, T040‑early‑alignment‑core).
